key_highlights: ASX ended a volatile week higher but faces downward pressure as Wall Street retreats on inflation fears and Fed hawkish commentary
Australian home values declined sharply in August; auction sentiment deteriorating, raising housing crash concerns
Aussie interest rate expectations rocket, with mortgage purchase rates rising week-on-week, pressuring RBA policy path
US military strikes on Iranian launchers in Strait of Hormuz elevate geopolitical risk and oil price volatility
Pilbara iron ore activity booms; Gateway Resources adds 7km gold trend in WA; Bapcor and X2M among ASX runners
Supermarket prices rising further, compounding household cost-of-living pressure
ASIC flags home insurance cash settlements short-changing vulnerable policyholders, creating regulatory risk for insurers
Virgin Australia shielded from oil shock via fuel hedging and new fleet; Qantas faces workforce redundancies

sectors.trend: Pilbara iron ore activity surging; Gateway Resources (GWR.AX) adds 7km gold trend in WA; Bapcor (BAP.AX) and X2M (X2M.AX) among weekly runners. Commodity backdrop supportive but US-Iran tension adds oil volatility.
sectors.implications: Positive for BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX on iron ore momentum. Gold miners (GWR.AX, NGM.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows amid geopolitical risk. Monitor iron ore pricing for sustained upside.

sectors.trend: Rising mortgage rates and deteriorating housing market (values down sharply, auctions weaker) pressure NIMs and credit quality. ASIC scrutiny of insurance payouts adds regulatory overhang. Interest rate expectations rising complicates RBA easing path.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from higher funding costs. Insurers (WBC.AX, CGF.AX) face ASIC enforcement risk. Housing-linked credit deterioration a medium-term concern.

sectors.trend: US-Iran Strait of Hormuz strikes spike oil risk premium. Virgin (QAN.AX) insulated via hedging/new fleet. Oil majors retreating on clean energy capex signals investor fatigue with transition spending.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil price spike. QAN.AX resilient. Clean-energy transition stocks face funding headwinds. Monitor Brent crude and LNG contract pricing.

sectors.trend: Supermarket prices rising further; fruit grower lays off ~1,000 workers. August data shows strong weight-loss drug demand, 'dupe' brand shift, and accelerating EV uptake.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOL.AX face input cost inflation but volume resilience. CSL.AX benefits from weight-loss drug demand. EV uptake supports long-term energy transition plays. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: Home values declining sharply; auction sentiment deteriorating; 'real housing crash' narrative emerging. Housing inflation remains a persistent RBA constraint.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Property developers (SRG.AX, PMV.AX) at risk. RBA constrained by housing inflation, delaying rate cuts.

sectors.trend: AI data centre demand transforming capex cycles (Caterpillar as tech proxy). Australia sets 'high bar' for fossil-fuel-powered data centres. SpaceX exploring AI data centre disruption.
sectors.implications: Supportive for AGL.AX, CSG.AX, INC.AX on data centre power demand. Regulatory framework may favour renewables. Long-term structural tailwind for energy infrastructure.

key_themes: Inflation persistence constraining RBA easing timeline
Housing market correction accelerating across capital cities
Geopolitical risk (US-Iran) driving oil volatility and safe-haven flows
AI/data centre capex as new structural growth driver
Commodity strength in iron ore and gold offsetting equity weakness

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to property-linked REITs and developers; favour banks with strong capital buffers (CBA.AX, NAB.AX); monitor NIM and arrears data.
Hedge oil exposure; maintain gold allocation (GWR.AX, NGM.AX); monitor Brent and AUD/USD for risk-off moves.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy constraint from housing inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Position for delayed rate cuts; favour dividend-paying large caps; avoid rate-sensitive small caps.
Review insurer balance sheets; favour well-capitalised players; monitor ASIC enforcement announcements.
Diversify away from US-listed tech; favour domestic ASX large caps; monitor AUD/USD for depreciation risk.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and iron ore miners on geopolitical risk and Pilbara supply momentum
opportunities.rationale: US-Iran tension drives safe-haven demand; Pilbara activity booming supports iron ore pricing; Gateway gold discovery adds exploration upside

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy infrastructure and power generators on AI data centre demand
opportunities.rationale: Structural capex cycle from AI; Australia's fossil-fuel data centre policy favours renewables and grid operators

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight CSL on weight-loss drug demand tailwind
opportunities.rationale: August data confirms strong Australian appetite for GLP-1 drugs; CSL's diversified pipeline benefits

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Sharp home value declines, weak auctions, and 'housing crash' narrative signal elevated downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge oil price volatility via energy majors or options
defensive_moves.rationale: Strait of Hormuz strikes create two-way oil risk; Virgin hedging model shows value of fuel risk management

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash or short-duration bonds pending RBA clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising rate expectations and housing inflation constrain easing; avoid locking in long-duration risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to open lower on Wall Street inflation fears and Fed hawkish tone. Volatility elevated. Geopolitical oil spike may support energy and materials but weigh on consumer and transport. Housing data remains a drag on sentiment. Expect range-bound trading with downside bias into RBA meeting.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from AI capex, commodity strength, and healthcare innovation support medium-term ASX recovery. However, housing correction and persistent inflation may delay RBA easing, capping multiple expansion. Diversification across materials, energy infrastructure, and healthcare offers best risk-adjusted returns.
